newsitem.title: JAPAN: Steel makers lower in morning session.
newsitem.headline: Steel makers lower in morning session.

text.p: Steel maker shares lost ground in the Monday morning session as investors moved to sell off large-capital issues, brokers said.
As of 0138 GMT, Kobe Steel Ltd was down 11 yen at 210 yen, the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo exchange, with turnover of 2.96 million shares.

Sumitomo Metal Industries Ltd, ranked second with 2.91 million shares traded, lost nine yen to 268 yen. It was followed by Nippon Steel Corp which was down 14 yen at 291 yen, on trade of 2.78 million shares.
Brokers said that foreign investors were responsible for most of the selling.
"The weakening of the yen against the dollar is adding slightly to the selling pressure," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
